seeded.note: Candidates seeded from a research agent's web-search summaries (see data/leads); unverified until the contest file cites the Secretary of State certified list. No stance questions set yet. Research notes: Kiley currently represents CA-3 (pre-Prop 50 lines) and is running in the new CA-6, so incumbent=false. Primary: Kiley 24.3%, Pan 23.2% (SoS Statement of Vote via search summary); Pan narrowly edged Stansfield for second. Pan's ballot designation was not reproduced in any search summary (one only described it vaguely as a doctor or health-advocate label), so it is null. Verify it on the certified list. A contact-list snippet showed Kiley with the designation Mother/Farmer; this is almost certainly a PDF parsing artifact, and the certified list shows United States Representative. Kiley's facts rest on secondary sources only: the web search budget ran out before a house.gov or bioguide search could be made, so his year of entering Congress and his birth details are not verified. A Wikipedia snippet gave the primary date as June 9, 2026, which is an error (it was June 2). A CalMatters article from October 2025 described Pan as running in CA-3, before the candidates chose their districts.
